x: Only A is correct: the Rowlatt Act and Jallianwala Bagh (1919) came under Chelmsford. The other pairs are wrong: Quit India (1942) and the August Offer (1940) both belong to Linlithgow, not Irwin or Wavell, and the Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931) belongs to Irwin, not Linlithgow.
Marquess Hastings was Governor-General from 1813 to 1823. 1805-07 was Sir George Barlow, 1823-28 was Amherst and 1807-13 was Minto I.
